details: Litecoin's blockchain underwent a three-hour rewrite to reverse a major exploit that affected its privacy layer. This unprecedented action aimed to undo the impact of the security breach.
title: Litecoin History Rewritten After Privacy-Layer Exploit

details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has filed a lawsuit against New York state, challenging its crackdown on prediction markets. The CFTC asserts its exclusive jurisdiction over these markets.
title: CFTC Sues New York Over Prediction Market Crackdown

details: Major DeFi protocols Aave, Kelp, and LayerZero have petitioned the Arbitrum DAO to release $71 million in frozen ETH, which is part of an effort to recover funds related to a prior exploit.
title: Aave, Kelp, LayerZero Request Arbitrum DAO Release of Frozen ETH

details: A 22-year-old individual has been sentenced to 70 months in prison for their involvement in a $263 million crypto money laundering syndicate, highlighting ongoing efforts to combat illicit activities in the crypto space.
title: 22-Year-Old Sentenced for $263 Million Crypto Money Laundering

details: Donald Trump voiced support for the CLARITY Act to establish a crypto regulatory framework, despite banking sector pushback. Simultaneously, BlackRock's spot Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) options open interest has surpassed Deribit, signaling growing institutional adoption.
title: Trump Backs CLARITY Act; BlackRock's IBIT Options Top Deribit

details: The Ethereum Foundation unstaked 17,035.326 ETH, valued at approximately $40 million, nearing its internal goal of 70,000 staked ETH. This move has led to speculation about potential future actions by the foundation.
title: Ethereum Foundation Unstakes 17,000 ETH

details: Bitcoin is trading around $78,000, and global crypto funds have attracted a significant $1.4 billion in inflows over the past week, marking the strongest inflow week since January. This suggests renewed investor confidence.
title: Bitcoin Holds $78K as Crypto Funds See $1.4 Billion Inflows

details: AWS Marketplace has integrated Chainlink's data feeds, data streams, and Proof of Reserve services, enhancing blockchain connectivity for developers building on Amazon Web Services.
title: AWS Marketplace Integrates Chainlink for Blockchain Connectivity

details: Crypto-focused venture capital firm Blockchain Capital is in the process of raising $700 million across two new funds: a second growth fund and a seventh early-stage fund, indicating continued institutional interest in the crypto space.
title: Blockchain Capital Aims for $700 Million in New Funds

details: The USDC Treasury has minted 250 million new USDC tokens, equivalent to approximately $249.9 million USD, reflecting ongoing demand and confidence in the stablecoin's utility and stability within the cryptocurrency market.
title: USDC Treasury Mints $250 Million in New Tokens
